correctness.rationale: Factor the triangular triple as (Ad,Bd,Be) with gcd(A,B)=gcd(d,e)=1 and relations Ab=Ba and dc=eb. Each residue modulo a=Ad has exactly one rectangular Apéry representative yb+zc for 0<=y<A,0<=z<d; reduction modulo d and then A proves uniqueness, while relations prove completeness. Identity a+c=2b+1 yields exact neighboring-residue coordinates. Interior 1<=z<=d-2 contributes only top two y rows, one gap each; z=0 contributes none and z=d-1 contributes B-1 gap levels for each top row. Edge cases n=3,4,6 handled with degenerating A. Count 2[(d-2)+(B-1)] gives stated parities and complete set. Independent Dijkstra-based residue enumeration and direct gap-neighbor tests checked every n from 3 through 33, but infinite correctness rests on the rectangular proof.
